<!--DESCRIPTION
|   My new environment setup.
|____________________________________________________________________-->

I’ve set up new development environments more times than I can count. Because I am constantly tinkering with my setup, I’ve compiled these pages as a resource for my standard applications and a guide on how to create configuration settings for tools like Git and Visual Studio Code.
